summary: A number input with increment and decrement buttons, in three sizes and three shapes.

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the control. Also a scrub area: drag left or right on it to change the value.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the control, for context on what the number means.
props.example: Days, then the files are deleted for good.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when you are not controlling it. Pair `value` with `onValueChange` instead if you are.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound. The decrement button disables at it.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound. The increment button disables at it.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount each click of increment or decrement changes the value by.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the buttons and the input together. The icon inside the buttons grows only at `lg`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the group's outer edges. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the whole control, label included.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk to the label & sets the input's native `required` attribute.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline, drawn around the input and both buttons together. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it; write them with `fw:`, since the group draws it while anything inside has focus. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.label: Keep deleted files for
props.description: Days, then the files are deleted for good.
